string.text: Coin finds steel, and steel finds work. I keep twenty wanderers on the slate, the same names in every town.
Twenty names. Refreshes every hour. Pay the purse, they join your party. Sold ones don't return.
Cheap hands for cheap coin. Rare talent costs a fortune. The slate shows the price.
Aye. Pick carefully. Once they're bought, they're gone from the slate.
My past is my own business. I am here to work, and I will do it well.
Your service ends here. Take what you have earned and go.
As you say. I will trouble you no further.
